description: Migration-flow state-conservation taxonomy for L1->L2 migration / reseed. Drives migration_flow_audit.py via migration_flow_taxonomy.classify(). UNLIKE the cross-chain/token/units lenses (per-item taggers), this lens ALSO emits cross_function_invariants — named conservation properties that span multiple functions, the class behind eval misses #242/#248/#451/#452/#462 where each function is locally correct but the migrated protocol state breaks globally.
_fp_note: FP backbone: an item is migration_flow_sensitive only with a MIGRATION-CONTEXT signal (file in a reseed/migration/L1/L2 path, OR a migration_context_terms hit in name/snippet). An ordinary SiloFacet deposit/withdraw/claim or a generic initializeOwner with NO migration context is NOT tagged. HIGH-RISK requires migration-context AND a state-domain signal. Comments stripped; a lone bridge constant (handled by the cross-chain lens) is not tagged unless inside a migration state-flow function.

migration_initializer.review_hint: Migration initializer/entrypoint. Confirm it writes a coherent, complete migrated state and cannot be partially applied or re-run.

reseed_initializer.review_hint: Reseed initializer (Reseed*.init). Confirm every global/per-account total it seeds is set exactly once, consistently, and in the right order relative to sibling reseed steps.

l1_to_l2_bridge.review_hint: L1->L2 bridge send path. If the L2 side can fail after the L1 side burns/locks, tokens may be stuck. Confirm atomicity / recoverability.

l2_receiver.review_hint: L2 receiver of L1 migration. Validate source (xDomainMessageSender / signature / merkle), payload, and replay protection; confirm the destination account binding cannot be hijacked.

migrated_deposit.review_hint: Writes a migrated deposit. Confirm amount AND bdv are preserved from the L1 snapshot, the deposit is pushed to the account's deposit-id list, and the stem/season is set so grown stalk is neither forfeited nor double-counted.

deposit_array_migration.review_hint: Deposit-id list maintenance during migration. A migrated deposit not pushed to the list becomes invisible to enumeration/withdraw (#248 class).

stalk_migration.review_hint: Migrated stalk accounting. Confirm migrated stalk == expected from deposit BDV + stem/season rules, and that per-user stalk sums to the seeded global total (#452 class).

roots_migration.review_hint: Migrated roots accounting. Roots must stay consistent with stalk and the global roots total (a desynced roots/stalk ratio mis-attributes earned Beans; replay inflates roots).
examples: global silo.roots seeding vs per-account roots

grown_stalk_recompute.review_hint: Grown-stalk recompute on migration. Confirm unmowed/grown stalk accrued on L1 is carried over (not forfeited) and not double-counted; the migrated stem must reflect the L1 grown-stalk position (#242 class).
examples: addMigratedDepositsToAccount setting stem without crediting unmowed grown stalk

plenty_migration.review_hint: Plenty / Season-of-Plenty balances on migration. Unclaimed plenty (and rain roots) must be migrated or remain claimable; resetting to 0 silently drops owed value.

fertilizer_migration.review_hint: Fertilizer/Barn migration. Confirm fertilized vs unfertilized entitlements (fertilizedIndex/fertilizedPaidIndex, humidity, id ordering) are preserved so no rinsable Bean is lost or double-paid.

unripe_migration.review_hint: Unripe migration. Keep unripe token balances distinct from underlying balances; recap/penalty accounting must carry over so chop/enroot value is preserved.

claimable_balance_migration.review_hint: Claimable / internal balances / pod orders on migration. Confirm farm balances AND outstanding orders (orderer Beans) are preserved; an un-migrated order leaves orderers' Beans stranded (#451 class).

token_mapping_migration.review_hint: L1->L2 token mapping / whitelist on migration. Confirm each L1 asset maps to the correct L2 token so migrated balances are credited to the right asset.

account_mapping_migration.review_hint: L1->L2 account binding. Confirm the destination account is bound in the signed/merkle leaf (cannot be redirected) and a migration cannot be replayed to a different receiver.

global_total_migration.review_hint: Global total seeding during reseed/migration. Confirm each global total (stalk, roots, deposited, internalTokenBalanceTotal) is initialized and equals the sum of the per-account values it aggregates.

user_total_migration.review_hint: Per-account total seeding. Must be consistent with both the underlying deposits and the global aggregate.

init_order_dependency.review_hint: Init-order dependency across reseed steps. Confirm no step reads state a later step seeds, and a revert mid-sequence cannot leave partially-initialized (and usable) state.

one_shot_guard.review_hint: One-shot guard. Confirm an initializer/migration entry cannot be called twice (re-seeding totals or re-crediting balances). Replayable migration inflates balances (#462/SN-003 class).

snapshot_baseline.review_hint: Hardcoded snapshot baselines fed into invariants/totals. Confirm placeholders are replaced with the true snapshot; a wrong baseline either bricks fundsSafu or understates the safety floor.

conservation_invariant.review_hint: Explicit conservation/entitlement check. Confirm the invariant actually enforces balances >= entitlements with correct, real (not placeholder) inputs across all migrated assets.

sum_of_users_vs_global.review_hint: Sum-of-users vs global consistency. The canonical migration conservation property: Σ per-account value == seeded global total for stalk, roots, deposited, internal balances. A mismatch silently mis-distributes (#452 class).

decimal_or_bdv_conversion.review_hint: BDV/decimal conversion during migration. Confirm migrated amounts are converted to BDV with the L2 rules (links to the units lens) so deposit value isn't silently rescaled.

cross_chain_message_validation.review_hint: Migration message/proof validation. Confirm source (messenger/signer/merkle root), payload integrity, nonce/spent-marker (no replay), and receiver binding.

cross_function_invariants.title: Migrated user deposits preserve amount and BDV
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: For each migrated deposit, the L2 (amount, bdv) equals the L1 snapshot (amount, bdv); no silent rescale or truncation.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Users receive deposits worth less/more than on L1; global BDV desyncs.

cross_function_invariants.title: Migrated stalk equals expected from BDV + stem/season
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Migrated account stalk == base stalk (bdv*stalkPerBdv) + grown stalk implied by the migrated stem/season.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: All migrated silo users receive less (or more) stalk than earned.

cross_function_invariants.title: Grown stalk not forfeited or double-counted on migrate
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Unmowed grown stalk accrued on L1 is credited exactly once via the migrated stem; not dropped, not duplicated.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Migrated deposits forfeit unmowed rewards (or inflate stalk).

cross_function_invariants.title: Global deposited/stalk totals == Σ migrated user values
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: After reseed, s.sys.silo.stalk/roots/totalDeposited == sum over accounts of the per-account values.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Global aggregates desync; earned-Bean distribution and invariants are wrong.

cross_function_invariants.title: Migrated deposit pushed to account deposit-id list
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Every migrated deposit is appended to the account's depositId list (enumerable/withdrawable).
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Migrated deposits are invisible to enumeration/withdraw — value stranded.

cross_function_invariants.title: Plenty and claimable/order balances preserved
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Unclaimed plenty, internal/farm balances, and outstanding pod orders survive migration and stay claimable.

cross_function_invariants.title: Fertilizer/unfertilized entitlements preserved
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: fertilizedIndex/fertilizedPaidIndex/humidity and id ordering reproduce L1 rinsable vs unrinsable Bean entitlements.

cross_function_invariants.title: Unripe balances not mixed with underlying
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Unripe token balances and their underlying balances are migrated as distinct quantities; recap/penalty preserved.

cross_function_invariants.title: L1->L2 token mapping preserves asset identity
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Each L1 asset maps to the correct L2 token; migrated balances credit the right asset.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Balances credited to the wrong/empty token.

cross_function_invariants.title: One-shot + atomic initialization (no replay, no partial state)
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Each migration/reseed entry runs at most once and either fully applies or fully reverts (no partial/usable intermediate state, no replay).
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Replay inflates balances; partial init bricks or strands tokens.

cross_function_invariants.title: L1/L2 receiver validates source and payload
cross_function_invariants.expected_conservation_property: Receiver authenticates the message source (messenger/signer/merkle), validates payload, binds the receiver, and prevents replay.
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: Spoofed/replayed migration mints or redirects migrated value.
